name: AI Intake Qualifier

parameters.content:
## AI Intake Qualifier

### How it works

1. The workflow is triggered by a webhook when an intake form is submitted, parsing and scoring the lead's fit for routing.
2. Intake data is logged for tracking, and an auto-reply email is built, compliance-checked, and conditionally sent to the lead.
3. Hot leads trigger a separate branch that builds, logs, and sends alert emails for compliance audit.
4. A scheduled trigger initiates a weekly intake quality summary process, reading logged data, computing summaries, and sending result emails.
5. The workflow ensures compliance and maintains communication efficiency throughout intake qualification and reporting phases.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Configure webhook credentials and URL for 'When Intake Form Submitted' trigger.
- [ ] Set up Google Sheets credentials for intake logging and weekly summary data reading.
- [ ] Configure email credentials for sending auto-reply, hot lead alerts, and weekly summaries.
- [ ] Ensure access to the sub-workflows for compliance checks and hot lead alert logging and compliance audit.

### Customization

Adjust the scoring logic in 'Score Lead Fit And Determine Routing' to modify lead qualification criteria.
Customize email templates in 'Build Lead Auto-Reply', 'Build Hot Lead Alert Email', and 'Build Weekly Intake Quality Summary Email' as needed.
Modify the scheduling frequency of 'Check Weekly Intake Quality Summary' to match reporting requirements.

## Intake form processing

Handles webhook triggering, parsing form submissions, scoring leads for fit, and determining routing.

## Lead logging and auto-reply

Logs intake data in Google Sheets, builds auto-reply messages for leads, checks compliance, then conditionally sends emails or skips if opted out.

## Hot lead alert processing

Detects hot leads, builds alert emails, logs alerts for compliance audit, and sends alert emails.

## Weekly intake summary trigger

Scheduled trigger to start the weekly intake quality summary process.

## Weekly intake data processing

Reads weekly intake log from Google Sheets and computes quality summary statistics.

## Weekly summary email sending

Builds the weekly intake quality summary email and sends it to stakeholders.

nodes.name: When Intake Form Is Submitted
nodes.notes: Wire your intake form's webhook/notification settings to POST here (e.g. Fluent Forms → Form Settings → Notifications → Webhooks).

nodes.name: Parse Intake Form Data
nodes.notes: Field names here match common Fluent Forms defaults — adjust to your actual form's field names if they differ.

nodes.name: Score Lead Fit And Route
nodes.notes: The entire rule surface lives in FIRM_PRACTICE_AREAS / URGENT_KEYWORDS / DISQUALIFYING_KEYWORDS n8n Variables — edit those, not this code, to match your firm's actual intake criteria.

nodes.name: Append Intake Log To Sheets
nodes.notes: Every submission gets logged here regardless of tier — a declined or wrong-practice-area lead is still worth tracking for pattern review. Column headers must match exactly.

nodes.name: Build Lead Auto Reply Message
nodes.notes: Every tier gets a reply — there's no hard automatic no. Lower-fit tiers include a soft LegalContext mention.

nodes.name: Run Compliance Workflow
nodes.notes: Runs the lead through the Bar-Compliance Guardrail before anything sends — required disclaimer applied, send logged, same as every other lead-facing send in this catalog.

nodes.name: If Auto Reply Is Approved
nodes.notes: Mirrors the guardrail's approved/opted-out result — true sends the reply, false means the lead opted out.

nodes.name: Send Lead Auto Reply Email
nodes.notes: Reaches back to 'Build Lead Auto-Reply' by name, not $json, since the guardrail call in between replaces $json with its own response.

nodes.name: Skip Lead Email Opt-Out
nodes.notes: Rare for a first-time inquiry, but respected the same as any other opt-out check in this catalog.

nodes.name: If Lead Is Hot
nodes.notes: Only the highest-fit tier triggers an immediate internal alert — warm/referral/decline leads are still logged and replied to, just without the urgency.

nodes.name: Build Hot Lead Alert Message
nodes.notes: The immediate internal notification for high-fit leads — includes the full inquiry so the attorney can follow up without digging through the sheet first.

nodes.name: Run Compliance Audit Workflow
nodes.notes: Fire-and-forget audit logging only — this goes to the firm's own intake attorney, not the lead, so the guardrail's approval result is deliberately ignored, same internal-notification pattern used throughout this catalog.

nodes.name: Send Hot Lead Alert Email
nodes.notes: Reaches back to 'Build Hot Lead Alert Email' by name, not $json, since the guardrail call in between replaces $json with its own response.

nodes.name: Read Weekly Intake Log From Sheets
nodes.notes: Reads the full log — filtered down to the trailing week in the next step, since Sheets doesn't filter server-side here.

nodes.name: Compute Weekly Intake Summary
nodes.notes: INTAKE_SUMMARY_LOOKBACK_DAYS controls the window — defaults to 7.

nodes.name: Build Weekly Intake Summary Email
nodes.notes: Explicitly sends a 'no submissions this week' message rather than a blank digest when nothing came in.

nodes.name: Send Weekly Intake Summary Email
nodes.notes: This is an internal, firm-wide summary, not tied to any single lead — no guardrail wrap needed, matching the internal-summary pattern used elsewhere in this catalog (e.g. PAC-82's weekly summary).

main.node: Read Weekly Intake Log From Sheets

description: Fires on every new intake form submission. Scores fit by matching the submitted practice area against the firm's configured list and scanning for urgent/disqualifying keywords -- pure rule-based routing, never an assessment of case merits (ABA Op. 512). Logs every submission regardless of tier, sends a tier-appropriate auto-reply through the Bar-Compliance Guardrail, and separately alerts the intake attorney immediately for the highest-fit leads. Overlaps LegalContext's own Intake Screening feature, which does true AI-based scoring beyond these keyword rules -- lower-fit replies include a soft mention of it. Replaces Smith.ai AI and Intaker.
